title: Course portal: year.json
description: One year of teaching. Lives in content/<year>/; the folder name is the year's id. List the folder in the years list of courses.json so the site shows it.

status.description: current: the year the course pages open on (only one year should be current). archived: shown under the Archive button. Nothing moves when you change it.

label.description: Only needed when the name shown should differ from the folder name.

note.description: One line shown on every course page this year. A course's sessions.json can set its own.

courses.description: Ids of the courses taught this year (from courses.json). Each has a folder here with a sessions.json.
